The examples are each one node covering the whole example block, not decomposed into the dialog inside them, per the rule that worked-example blocks are one node.

The drug-use example and resignation-letter example both demonstrate the same principle but from different angles; kept them as separate nodes because each is a distinct example block with distinct content.
